doc.brief: Describes changes in a filter in more detail and allows objects using the filter to optimize refiltering items.
doc.md:
Describes changes in a filter in more detail and allows objects
using the filter to optimize refiltering items.

If you are writing an implementation and are not sure which
value to pass, `GTK_FILTER_CHANGE_DIFFERENT` is always a correct
choice.

New values may be added in the future.

different.brief: The filter change cannot be described with any of the other enumeration values
different.md:
The filter change cannot be
  described with any of the other enumeration values

different_rewatch.brief: Similar to [`FilterChange.DIFFERENT`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FilterChange#value:DIFFERENT), but signs that item watches should be recreated.
different_rewatch.md:
Similar to [`FilterChange.DIFFERENT`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FilterChange#value:DIFFERENT),
but signs that item watches should be recreated. This is used by
[`FilterListModel`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FilterListModel) to keep the list up-to-date when items
change.

less_strict.brief: The filter is less strict than it was before: All items that it used to return true still return true, others now may, too.
less_strict.md:
The filter is less strict than
  it was before: All items that it used to return true
  still return true, others now may, too.

less_strict_rewatch.brief: Similar to [`FilterChange.LESS_STRICT`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FilterChange#value:LESS_STRICT), but signs that item watches should be recreated.

more_strict.brief: The filter is more strict than it was before: All items that it used to return false still return false, others now may, too.
